usageNotes: Use this to enumerate the top-level SDN API sub-resources available on the cluster (e.g. vnets, zones, controllers, ipams). It is a directory index only — it returns child resource IDs, not SDN configuration data itself. Requires the SDN.Audit privilege on /sdn; SDN must be enabled in the cluster (datacenter configuration) for child resources to be present.

examples.summary: List SDN sub-resource categories available on the cluster

tips: If the returned array is empty or SDN child routes are missing, verify that SDN is enabled in Datacenter > Options > SDN.
This endpoint is a navigation index — follow the returned 'id' values as path segments to reach actual SDN objects (e.g. GET /cluster/sdn/vnets, /cluster/sdn/zones).
API tokens are supported; ensure the token has SDN.Audit on /sdn.
